rules.title: Invalid CRC-16 or Endianness Transposition
rules.description: The computed CRC-16 (ANSI 0xA001) does not match the received frame tail, or bytes are received Big-Endian instead of Modbus standard Little-Endian (Low-byte first).
rules.reference: Modbus over Serial Line Specification V1.02 Section 2.5.1.2

rules.title: Off-by-One Register Addressing Mismatch
rules.description: PLC register notation (e.g. Holding Register 40001) used directly as PDU protocol address without subtracting offset 1 (Protocol address must be 0x0000).
rules.reference: Modbus Application Protocol Specification V1.1b3 Section 4.4

rules.title: Modbus RTU 3.5 Character Frame Timeout Violation
rules.description: Inter-frame gap between consecutive frames was less than 3.5 character times, causing packet merger and framing collision on the RS-485 bus.
rules.reference: Modbus over Serial Line Specification V1.02 Section 2.5.1.1

rules.title: Slave Exception Response Received
rules.description: Slave responded with exception indicator bit set (Function Code | 0x80) and returned error code (0x01, 0x02, 0x03, or 0x04).
rules.reference: Modbus Application Protocol Specification V1.1b3 Section 7

rules.title: Request Quantity Exceeds Protocol Boundary
rules.description: Requested quantity of holding registers exceeds 125 registers (0x007D) or coils exceeds 2000 (0x07D0) in a single transaction frame.
rules.reference: Modbus Application Protocol Specification V1.1b3 Section 6.3
